tabs.label: device
tabs.summary: One column per connected Airstick. Columns appear on their own when a stick starts sending.

components.name: Tabs
components.text: Switch between the four pages: device, visual, control and system.

components.name: Device number
components.text: Which Airstick this column is.

components.name: Network
components.text: The IP address and port the stick's data is arriving from.

components.name: Battery
components.text: Charge reported by the stick.

components.name: Plotter
components.text: Live trace of the signals the loaded personality chooses to show. Goes flat while the device is muted.

components.name: 3D view
components.text: The stick's orientation. The box turns with the stick; the small yellow, magenta and cyan bars show acceleration. Tap to calibrate.

components.name: Personality
components.text: The loaded personality, in the device's colour. Tap to mute or unmute; it greys out when muted.

components.name: Previous / next
components.text: Load the previous or next personality in this kit's roster.

components.name: Visual surface
components.text: All devices drawn on one canvas (Overlay) or one canvas each (Grid); switch on the system page. When the visuals are on a second screen this reads "visuals on HDMI".

tabs.label: control
tabs.summary: Per-device settings. Moves here are shared with the web app and MIDI, and are remembered between sessions.

components.name: Sliders
components.text: Drag across to set each parameter: volume, sensitivity and any the personality adds. Some personalities show their own controls here instead.

components.name: Personality
components.text: Same as on the device page: tap to mute or unmute.

components.name: Previous / next
components.text: Same as on the device page.

tabs.label: system
tabs.summary: Health of the kit, and the buttons that act on the whole system.

components.name: Load
components.text: System Load is CPU use across the Pi; SC Load is AirKit's share. Temp and Fan are the Pi's temperature and fan state.

components.name: Audio server
components.text: Audio engine CPU, and how many UGens, groups and synths are running.

components.name: Hosting / Port
components.text: This kit's IP address and port: what the web app and Airsticks should point at.

components.name: Meters
components.text: Input and output levels.

components.name: Node tree
components.text: What is currently running on the audio server.

components.name: Version
components.text: The installed AirKit version.

components.name: Overlay / Grid
components.text: Visuals as one shared canvas, or one canvas per device.

components.name: Panel / HDMI
components.text: Show the visuals on this panel or on a second screen. Pressing HDMI checks for a screen; with none plugged in it snaps back to Panel.

components.name: Network
components.text: Restarts the Pi's networking. Try this if sticks or the web app lose connection.

components.name: OSC Thru
components.text: Forward the incoming Airstick data to another computer (set in the kit's machine file).

components.name: Free All buffers
components.text: Unload every sample from memory.

components.name: Free All Nodes
components.text: Stop every sound immediately.

components.name: QUIT
components.text: Quit AirKit.

components.name: TURN OFF
components.text: Shut the Pi down. Wait for the screen to go dark before unplugging.
